summary: Phase 9C round 4 (Batch B) backend regression — cs.py, dc.py, grn.py, mrf.py, po.py router extraction is byte-identical. New pytest suite `test_phase9c_r4_batch_b.py` (38 tests, ~0.6s) covers CS/DC/GRN/MRF/PO RBAC, workflow, threshold-based PO approvals, auto-GRN on PO receive, MRF line-edit change_log, and OpenAPI presence. Combined with r2 (21) and r3 (45) = 104/104 pytest pass. LLM UAT exit=0. All 32 required OpenAPI paths present. No RBAC drift, no behavioural drift.

minor.issue: Audit `new_value` records `status: 'issued'` (routers/dc.py:88) but the DC Pydantic model default is `status='pending_approval'` (server.py:373). Actual DB row is pending_approval; only the audit metadata claims 'issued'. Pre-existing drift preserved from server.py — not introduced by refactor.

action_items: Minor (non-blocking): routers/dc.py:88 audit `new_value.status='issued'` disagrees with DC model default `pending_approval`. Either flip the audit hint to `pending_approval` OR set DC.status default to 'issued' if that's the intended UX after `create`. This is pre-existing drift from server.py — flagging for consistency, but does not affect any test or runtime behaviour.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/po.py:99 — In auto-approval branch, MRF's `all_ordered` check uses `>= (mi.get('qty_approved') or 0)` which incorrectly rolls to `fully_ordered` when qty_approved=0 (rejected lines already filtered by status!='rejected'). Same guard exists on the /approve path (line 181). Byte-identical to server.py — not introduced by refactor. Consider `>` semantics or per-line rejected filter.

routers/mrf.py:342-399 — Line-edit endpoint pops 'reason' from body before checking editable_fields; reason handling is clean. Note that `_check_mrf_access` is called BEFORE the role check, meaning site_engineer trying to edit somebody else's MRF gets 403 from the access check rather than the role guard — same result, but the ordering is worth noting for future auditors.

routers/cs.py:196-198 — Approve rejects states not in {pending_approval, rejected, active} — 'approved' therefore returns 400 on 2nd approve (verified). 'active' is retained for legacy CS documents; if the app never writes that state, consider removing it.

routers/po.py:222-225 — site_engineer PO list uses set intersection on mrf_refs — correct, but reads all POs into memory first (`docs`). Fine for current scale; if PO count grows into 10k+, consider MongoDB $in aggregation instead of Python filter.

server.py:2854 — Down from 5276 (46% reduction). Router registration block imports 9 routers before app.include_router(api). Router-import side-effects (each router calls @api.<method>) mean import order does not matter functionally, but the `from server import ...` inside each router creates a circular import that works only because server.py registers routers AFTER defining all symbols they need — fragile if anyone reorders those blocks.

success_rate.backend: 100% (104/104 pytest + 0 LLM UAT failures + 32/32 OpenAPI paths)

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed idempotent via admin fixture. All test data prefixed with TEST_R4_ (MRFs, DCs, CS titles, remarks). Test MRFs & CS are soft-deleted at end of respective test classes; PO/GRN test rows remain in DB (searchable by TEST_R4 in remarks).
